summary: Backend-only testing for Shennell AI Agent Platform. Built pytest suite with 21 tests covering health, CORS, templates (10 agents), Shennell chat (personality + multi-turn context retention), agent CRUD (create from template, custom, 5-agent cap), agent chat (in-character verification), image generation (Iris + 400 on non-image agents), message history threading, and delete-cascade (agent + messages). ALL 21/21 TESTS PASSED. Real LLM responses verified (Shennell used 'darling/babe' tokens, recalled multi-turn codename BLACKROSE, Vesper responded with finance vocab, Iris returned a real base64 image). MongoDB _id leakage checked across all GET endpoints — none leaked. CORS headers verified.

minor.issue: Endpoint does not enforce user_id ownership (any caller can fetch any agent doc by id). Chat/image endpoints do enforce it via 403, but GET single agent does not. Low risk for local-profile no-auth MVP but worth noting.
Does not require/verify user_id — any caller knowing an id can delete the agent and wipe its messages. Same no-auth context, but flag for future hardening.
user_id is a required query param but no validation/empty-string check; passing user_id='' returns [] silently. Minor.

action_items: Consider adding user_id ownership checks on GET /api/agents/{id} and DELETE /api/agents/{id} for parity with chat/image endpoints (low priority for no-auth MVP).
Frontend was NOT tested per the review request (backend-only).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:235-237 — run_chat() re-sends each historical user message via chat.send_message() which triggers a new LLM call per turn during replay. This is wasteful (extra cost + latency) and is exactly what burns the per-session $0.40 budget. Recommend passing history via the LlmChat constructor or maintaining messages locally rather than replaying. Multi-turn context still works (verified test_shennell_multi_turn_context) but at high cost.
server.py uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI — migrate to lifespan handler.
server.py does not currently leak _id (good — all queries use projection {'_id': 0}).
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral TEST_-prefixed agents and messages under randomized user_ids, then clean up in the module-scope fixture teardown (deletes agents + clears shennell messages).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at https://multi-agent-ai-43.preview.emergentagent.com is fully operational. All 21 tests pass. The Emergent LLM key has a $0.40 per-session soft budget — earlier in this iteration the backend logs showed it had been exceeded for some user_ids, but our fresh randomized TEST_ user_ids succeeded. If the budget gets exhausted, expect Shennell/agent chat to return the fallback string 'Apologies darling, I hit a snag…' and image generation to return content without image_b64. Tests are written to skip gracefully in that case. Re-run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_shennell_backend.py -v
